allow: PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { Write-Output "Killing PID $\($p.Id\) \($\($p.ProcessName\)\)"; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } } } else { Write-Output "Nothing listening on port 3000" })

PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { Write-Output "Port 3000 IS in use by:"; $c.OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName } } else { Write-Output "Port 3000 is FREE" }; Write-Output "--- node processes ---"; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime)

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $n = \(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object\).Count; Write-Output "Remaining node processes: $n")
